'''Nathanael Leedom Ackerman''' (born March 4, 1978),<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Ackerman, Nathanael Leedon (GBR) |url=https://whatsmat.uww.org/daten.php?spid=B71507360C794F80AB78E0C16401D490 |access-date=2023-12-15 |website=whatsmat.uww.org}}</ref> known as '''Nate Ackerman''', is a British-American [[mathematician]] and [[Wrestling|wrestler]]. He is the son of [[Peter Ackerman]] and [[Joanne Leedom-Ackerman]].

== Biography ==
Ackerman was born in [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States to [[Joanne Leedom-Ackerman]] and [[Peter Ackerman]]. He was educated at the [[American School in London]]<ref>{{citation|title=MIT brains, brawn and bright lights go to Athens Olympics|journal=MIT News|publisher=[[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]]|url=http://newsoffice.mit.edu/2004/olympics|first=Denise|last=Brehm|date=August 13, 2004}}</ref> and then [[Harvard University]], where he graduated in June 2000.

Ackerman competed in the [[2004 Summer Olympics|2004 Summer Olympic Games]] as part of the [[Great Britain at the 2004 Summer Olympics|Great Britain National Team]].<ref name=Guardian>{{cite web |last=Phillips |first=Michael |title=Britain's only wrestler grapples with a crowd |url=https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2004/may/25/athensolympics2004.olympicgames |date=25 May 2004 |work=Athens 2004 |publisher=The Guardian |accessdate=14 July 2009}}</ref> He also competed in the [[1999 World Wrestling Championships|1999]], [[2001 World Wrestling Championships|2001]], 2002, 2003, 2005 and 2011 World Championships.<ref>[https://www.iat.uni-leipzig.de/datenbanken/dbfoeldeak/daten.php?spid=B71507360C794F80AB78E0C16401D490 Ackerman, Nathanael Leedon (GBR)]. FILA Wrestling Database. Retrieved on 20 July 2009.</ref> Ackerman's best international finish was fifth at the 2011 Commonwealth Championship.<ref name=":0" />

Ackerman was a two-times winner of the [[British Wrestling Championships]] at welterweight in 2002 and 2004.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://britishwrestling.org/about-british-wrestling/history-of-wrestling/british-senior-champions-2002-to-2008/ |title=British Senior Champions 2002 to 2008 |website=British Wrestling |access-date=20 December 2025}}</ref>

He received his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in mathematics in 2006 from [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]].<ref>{{mathGenealogy|98770}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis | type=Ph.D. thesis | url=http://www.math.harvard.edu/~nate/papers/misc/thesis/thesis.pdf | author=Nathanael Leedom Ackerman | title=On Quantifier Rank Spectrum of L-Infinity-Omega | institution=Massachusetts Institute of Technology | year=2006 }}</ref>
